في إطار مواصلة القافلة الوطنية التضامنية: As part of the continuation of the national solidarity convoy for the 2026/2027 school year
Ooredoo الجزائر والكشافة الإسلامية الجزا: Ooredoo Algeria and the Algerian Muslim Scouts continue their solidarity convoy in the wilayas affected by forest fires
في إطار مواصلة القافلة الوطنية التضامنية: As part of the continuation of the national solidarity convoy launched by Ooredoo in partnership with the Algerian Muslim Scouts on the occasion of the 2026/2027 school year, Ooredoo and the Algerian Muslim Scouts launched a special solidarity convoy to the wilayas recently affected by forest fires, notably the wilayas of Jijel, Béjaïa, and Tizi Ouzou, including the distribution of school bags and supplies for needy children.
تأتي هذه العملية تحت شعار \"لكل طفل فرصة: This operation comes under the slogan "Every child has a chance to succeed, let's contribute to achieving it", embodying on the ground the special solidarity convoy announced during the official launch ceremony recently organized at the International Scout Center in Algiers. It also reflects Ooredoo's participation in the national solidarity drive alongside the Algerian Muslim Scouts.
وفي هذا الإطار، جاب ممثلو Ooredoo على رأ: In this context, Ooredoo representatives, led by the Director of Corporate Affairs, Media Relations, and Corporate Social Responsibility, Mr. Ramdane Djezairi, and volunteers alongside members of the National Directorate of the Algerian Muslim Scouts, toured a number of municipalities across the three wilayas, with the aim of meeting the beneficiary children and directly distributing school bags and supplies to them, coinciding with the 2026/2027 school year.
وقد حطّت القافلة التضامنية رحالها، على و: The solidarity convoy stopped, in particular, in the municipalities of Taher and Djemaa Beni Habihi in the wilaya of Jijel, the municipalities of Melbou and Boukhelifa in the wilaya of Béjaïa, as well as the municipality of Boghni in the wilaya of Tizi Ouzou, where volunteer teams distributed school bags and supplies to the beneficiary children and provided them with direct support on the ground.
تأتي هذه العملية في سياق حرائق الغابات ا: This operation comes in the context of the recent forest fires that affected a number of areas in these three wilayas, reflecting Ooredoo's keenness to continue standing by the families concerned and providing them with tangible support on the occasion of the school start.
كما تساهم هذه العملية في تعزيز الشراكة ا: This operation also contributes to strengthening the sustainable partnership between Ooredoo and the Algerian Muslim Scouts, which is based on shared values of solidarity, citizenship, and mutual aid, and falls within the framework of continuing the joint initiatives implemented by both parties for the benefit of needy children and families.
يجدر التذكير بأن Ooredoo، بالتعاون مع ال: It is worth recalling that Ooredoo, in cooperation with the National Volunteer Association (ANV), contributed to the national solidarity drive for the families affected by the forest fires that hit the wilaya of Jijel, by organizing an operation to distribute aid and basic necessities to those affected.
ومن خلال هذه القافلة التضامنية الخاصة، ت: Through this special solidarity convoy, Ooredoo renews its civic commitment and eagerness to contribute to the implementation of tangible community-based initiatives in the service of society.
